title: Build ExplorerPanel with document tree and keyboard shortcuts
description:
Create `dashboard/frontend/components/define/explorer-panel.tsx` with the slide-in document explorer.

Implement ExplorerPanel component:
- **Position**: `position: fixed`, left side, 260px width, z-index above grid
- **Background**: --color-bg-elevated, shadow `8px 0 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)`
- **Toggle**: Cmd+E (Mac) / Ctrl+E (Windows) keyboard shortcut
- **Dismiss**: Escape key, close button click
- **Focus trap**: When open, Tab cycles through explorer items only. Focus returns to trigger element on close.
- **Document tree**: Features grouped with PRD/RFC/DSN indicators per feature. Each feature shows its name and which specs exist.
- **Click behavior**: Clicking a spec navigates to Spec Editor with that spec loaded (use Next.js router)
- **Animation**: `transform: translateX(-100%)` to `translateX(0)` over 200ms ease. Respects `prefers-reduced-motion` (instant transition).
- **Accessibility**: `role='dialog'`, `aria-modal='true'`, `aria-label='Document explorer'`
- **Close button**: --color-text-tertiary, hover --color-text
- **Item hover**: `rgba(255,255,255,0.02)` background
- **Internal scroll**: Content scrolls within panel, panel itself is fixed height (viewport height minus header)
- **Padding**: 16px internal

Integrate into the Define page by updating `app/define/page.tsx`:
- Add keyboard event listener and ExplorerPanel render
- Import DefectRow from `@/components/define/defect-row` and SectionDivider from `@/components/define/section-divider`
- Replace the placeholder divs in the defect section (lines 293-324) with SectionDivider and DefectRow components
acceptance_criteria:
- ExplorerPanel renders at 260px width with fixed positioning
- Panel slides in on Cmd+E and slides out on Escape
- Panel has focus trap when open
- Document tree shows features grouped with spec indicators
- Clicking a spec navigates to Spec Editor route
- Close button dismisses panel
- Panel uses role='dialog' with aria-modal='true'
- Animation respects prefers-reduced-motion
- Panel has --color-bg-elevated background with correct shadow
- Defect section in page.tsx uses SectionDivider and DefectRow components (no placeholder divs)

rationale: The Explorer panel is the most interactive component with keyboard shortcuts, focus management, and animation. Depends on tasks 9-11 because it modifies page.tsx (which those tasks also reference), and the page should have its core grid content before adding the overlay. The dependency chain through page.tsx: task 8 creates it, tasks 9-11 provide cell components, task 12 adds the explorer overlay last.
assumptions: Spec Editor route exists or will be a no-op navigation for now (out of scope per product spec)
Focus trap implemented with vanilla JS/React (no library dependency needed)
